The institutional investor held 42,000 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.20 million, down from 46,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Smithbridge Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Interdigital Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.73B market cap company. It also increased its holding in Apple Computer Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 36,449 shares in the quarter, for a total of 120,675 shares, and has risen its stake in Raytheon Co (NYSE:RTN).
